[[File:Traders_Plaza_TEGTPM.jpg|thumb|250px|Atzerri Trader's Plaza and spaceport]]
The '''Trader's Plaza''' was a district in [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]] on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] where almost anything, [[Black market/Legends|legal or illegal]], could be had for a price. Arriving visitors ran a gauntlet of gaudily lit stores that were designed to hook new arrivals and separate them from their credits as soon as possible. The [[Galactic Archives]] operated a satellite shop in the Trader's Plaza during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. While searching for information on [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his mother]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] member [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|Akanah]] visited the Trader's Plaza.
